62.sourceTitle: Aluminium Premium Duty paid US Midwest Price Today - Investing.com
62.evidenceText: Aluminium Premium Duty paid US Midwest historical data showing 1,793.99 USD, but this appears to be a futures contract price rather than the premium in USD/lb
62.extractionRationale: The source shows a value of 1,793.99 with currency in USD, but this figure is inconsistent with typical aluminum premium quotes which are measured in fractions of dollars per pound (usually 0.10-0.50 range). The displayed value appears to be a futures contract price rather than the actual premium in USD/lb. The specific premium value in USD per pound format is not clearly provided in the evidence.
